title: Ballyrub, Ballinspittle, Kinsale, Co. Cork, P17NH56
seoTitle: Ballyrub, Ballinspittle, Kinsale, Co. Cork, P17NH56
description:
Bowe Property presents to the market a beautiful vernacular Irish farmhouse which has been flawlessly updated and extended, sitting on a plot of ground of approx. 0.3 acres in a most scenic & convenient of settings, with a choice of two fine sand beaches a mere 4kms away, Ballinspittle village just 3.5kms, the internationally renowned Kinsale harbour town a little over 7kms away, and Cork International Airport an easy, direct 30km drive. Sitting in a wonderful, verdant, rolling countryside setting, this property is truly a beautiful home offering the best of country, coastal lifestyle living. Accommodation is set over two floors and consists of three bedrooms, bathroom, together with a front lounge and a dual-aspect kitchen/dining room with double doors onto private rear lawned and vegetable gardens. The kitchen/dining room is fitted with hand-crafted presses & cupboard and further features throughout the property include ornate ceramic tiling, wooden floors, solid fuel stove, double-glazed sash windows, exposed beams, oil-fired central heating & much, much more. An outside utilities store is accessible off the kitchen, as well as a separate block built garden shed to the rear. The site is wonderfully private with a natural sunny orientation, and the entire property is set behind automated traditional farm gates. This is a property ready to move into, but equally offering further potential to enlarge, if required (planning permission granted.) An opportunity to enjoy the best of country, coastal living in a beautiful part of the Kinsale, Old Head and Ballinspittle area. 

Viewing of this home is highly recommended and strictly by prior appointment.

Ceramic tiled splashback. Earthenware sink. Window to side with exquisite countryside views. Double doors onto rear patio & gardens. Recessed lighting. Wooden floor. 
Dining Section 4.2m x 3.1m
Glazed door to hallway. Large sash window onto front drive. Sash window onto side. Wooden floor. 


Utility Room-6.7m x 2.62m
Extensive storage. Plumbed and fitted with washing services. Door to front. Exposed beams. 


Landing -4m x 2.07m 
Access to bedrooms, bathroom & airing cupboard. Attic hatch with folding stairs. 


Bedroom 1 -4.19m x 3.47m 
Two built-in robes. Large sash window to front. Large sash window to side with rolling countryside views. Wooden floors. Radiator. 


Bedroom 2 -2.72m x 2.42m 
Window to front. Wooden floors. Radiator. 


Bathroom -4.18m x 2.54m
Fully fitted with w.c., wash-hand basin, oversized bathtub & large shower with rainfall & telephone shower attachments. Ceramic tiled walls & floor. Sash window to side with rolling countryside views. Radiator.

Large sash window to side with rolling countryside views.  Large sash window to rear with rolling countryside views. Wooden floor. Radiator.
